sentences.text: Di terminal, seorang seniman sedang memahat patung kayu, dan Siti berhenti untuk menonton.
sentences.en: In the terminal, an artist was carving a wooden statue, and Siti stopped to watch.
sentences.ko: 터미널에서 한 예술가가 나무 조각상을 깎고 있어서 시티는 멈춰서 구경했어요.

sentences.text: Pasien cilik itu melambai kepada Budi dari jendela mobil saat pulang.
sentences.en: The young patient waved to Budi from the car window on the way home.
sentences.ko: 꼬마 환자는 퇴원하면서 차창 밖으로 부디에게 손을 흔들었어요.

sentences.text: Siti melambai kepada keluarganya dari balik kaca pemeriksaan.
sentences.en: Siti waved to her family from behind the security glass.
sentences.ko: 시티는 검색대 유리 너머로 가족에게 손을 흔들었어요.

sentences.text: Budi menutup pintu supaya pasangan tua itu bisa berduaan sebentar.
sentences.en: Budi closed the door so the elderly couple could be alone together for a while.
sentences.ko: 부디는 노부부가 잠시 둘만 있을 수 있게 문을 닫아 줬어요.

sentences.text: Setelah anak-anak tertidur, Siti dan suaminya akhirnya bisa berduaan di ruang tunggu.
sentences.en: After the kids fell asleep, Siti and her husband could finally have some time alone in the lounge.
sentences.ko: 아이들이 잠든 뒤에야 시티와 남편은 대합실에서 둘만의 시간을 가질 수 있었어요.

sentences.text: Budi mencatat bahwa tangan kiri adalah tangan dominan pasien itu.
sentences.en: Budi noted that the left hand is that patient's dominant hand.
sentences.ko: 부디는 그 환자가 왼손잡이라고 기록했어요.

sentences.text: Siti memperhatikan warna biru yang dominan di desain terminal baru itu.
sentences.en: Siti noticed the blue that dominates the design of the new terminal.
sentences.ko: 시티는 새 터미널 디자인에 파란색이 두드러진다는 걸 알아챘어요.

sentences.text: Pria berotot itu ternyata takut melihat jarum, cerita Budi sambil tertawa.
sentences.en: That muscular man turned out to be scared of needles, Budi said with a laugh.
sentences.ko: 부디는 그 근육질 남자가 알고 보니 주삿바늘을 무서워했다며 웃었어요.

sentences.text: Seorang porter berotot membantu Siti mengangkat koper besar ke timbangan.
sentences.en: A muscular porter helped Siti lift her big suitcase onto the scale.
sentences.ko: 근육질 짐꾼이 시티를 도와 큰 캐리어를 저울에 올려 줬어요.
